$comment: Addresses are public. Private keys never go in this file, or any file in this repo.
$treasury: Quadpad's own, not Tollpad's — configAddress refuses Tollpad's two outright. `treasury` becomes an immutable in QuadHook from `npm run deploy` onwards and no function anywhere moves it, so this is the last moment it can be changed.
$launch: Nothing to configure. The opening price, the range and the tick spacing are constants in QuadpadFactory.sol — see OPENING_TICK.
